decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform sits at the core of the firm's established offer and got more prominent in 2019, so it likely meets aspirations, and in a growing industry the firm has the slack to keep carrying it.

Mobile field data capture is close to the core business and was steadily presented on its own page, so it shows no shortfall that would prompt problemistic search, though the firm has already pruned weaker mobile and plugin items.

The search extension was still being actively versioned in 2019, which signals satisfactory results, but the firm already dropped a similar search plugin (B), so consolidation into a single search component is a modest risk.
